paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Nadav. In Arakhin 16, beginning of side b: R' Shmuel bar Nadav asked R' Hanina. Some say: R' Shmuel bar Nadav, R' Hanina's son-in-law, asked R' Hanina; others say, R' Yehoshua ben Levi.
